E4Plus1.uk.description: Whanex?: While preparing a presentation for his students about future goals, Cam must contend with a bully at the school. Jay has technical trouble during a video conference. (S10 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: We Need to Talk About Lily: Phil thinks he's found Pepper's dream home. Mitch and Cam get invited to an exclusive event. (S10 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Boy-Scoutz 'n the Hood: During an all-syrup Squishee bender, Bart joins the junior campers and ends up taking the embarrassing - and dangerous - Homer on a river rafting trip. (S5 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: $pringfield (or How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling): Homer gets a job at Mr Burns' new casino and Marge gets addicted to the slot machines. (S5 Ep10/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer the Vigilante: Homer sets up a chaotic vigilante group to combat one-man crime spree Molloy (guest star Sam Neill). (S5 Ep11/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Last Temptation of Homer: Homer falls for his beautiful new colleague Mindy Simmons (guest star Michelle Pfeiffer), who shares his love of doughnuts... (S5 Ep9/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Simple Simpson: Homer becomes masked vigilante the 'Pie Man' but gets an offer that tempts him away from his crime-fighting ways, which could be bad news for the Dalai Lama... (S15 Ep19/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Black-Eyed, Please: Flanders loses his cool when his laid-back parents start to prefer Homer's company to his own. Lisa is bullied by her new substitute teacher (Tina Fey). (S24 Ep15/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck Mediterranean
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Two of the crew commit a major betrayal - but they're not sure if they should feel guilty. Romantic entanglements on board get messy. (S10 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: This time, the Goggleboxers watch: Wildlife Rescue, Expedition X and Jamie's Air Fryer Meals. Also Baby Reindeer, Teen First Dates and The Circle. (S23 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: What do the Goggleboxers make of Britain's Got Talent, Baby Reindeer, Red Eye, Love Triangle, In with a Shout, The Yorkshire Vet and a This Morning feature on bras? (S23 Ep11)

Film4.uk.title: Top Gun: Maverick
Film4.uk.description: (2022) Danger-zone action as Tom Cruise returns to the cockpit after 36 years. He's Maverick. He still feels the need for speed. And there's a near-impossible mission to fly. With Jon Hamm.

Film4.uk.title: The Equalizer 2
Film4.uk.description: (2018) Action crime thriller sequel. Denzel Washington returns as Robert McCall, who's out for revenge after ruthless killers murder an agency contact who he also considered a friend.

Film4.uk.title: Hit the Road
Film4.uk.description: (2021) Evocative and tender comedy drama tracking the ups and downs and round and rounds of a family on a road trip to get their eldest child out of Iran. In Persian/subs.

Film4.uk.description: Teleshopping.

Film4.uk.description: Teleshopping.

Film4.uk.title: Halls of Montezuma
Film4.uk.description: (1951) Second World War drama. Richard Widmark stars as a commanding officer leading US Marines into the Pacific to capture Japanese prisoners and discover the location of a rocket base.

Film4.uk.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
Film4.uk.description: (1957) David Lean's Oscar-winning fact-based Second World War classic stars Alec Guinness as the driven commander of a group of POWs building a rail bridge for the Japanese.

Film4.uk.title: The Enemy Below
Film4.uk.description: (1957) Second World War thriller. Robert Mitchum stars as the captain of a US destroyer in the North Atlantic hunting down a German U-boat and its world-weary captain, Curt Jurgens.

Film4.uk.title: Oblivion Interview Special
Film4.uk.description: Tom Cruise, Olga Kurylenko and Joseph Kosinski discuss the making of sci-fi adventure Oblivion.

Film4.uk.title: Uncharted
Film4.uk.description: (2022) Going-for-gold action. Tom Holland and Mark Wahlberg compare abs as they scour the globe for an olde explorer's lost gold. The heat is on. The time is right. Only the best survive.

Film4.uk.title: Anna
Film4.uk.description: (2019) Luc Besson's action-thriller about a young Russian assassin, with Sasha Luss. A scout offers Anna an opportunity to become a model in Paris, but can she escape her links to the KGB?

Film4.uk.title: Venom
Film4.uk.description: (2018) Dark sci-fi action starring Tom Hardy as Marvel's anti-hero. A reporter becomes inhabited by a ferocious alien that has its own ideas on how to behave. With Michelle Williams.

Film4.uk.title: How to Get Ahead in Advertising
Film4.uk.description: (1989) Surreal satire from Bruce Robinson, director of Withnail & I. Richard E Grant plays a manic adman who sees the error of his ways after he grows a second head.

Film4.uk.title: A Foreign Affair
Film4.uk.description: (1948) Billy Wilder's film stars Jean Arthur and Marlene Dietrich as the chalk-and-cheese women in post-war Berlin with John Lund as the man caught between them.

Film4.uk.title: Inglourious Basterds Interview...
Film4.uk.description: ...Special: The director, Quentin Tarantino, together with stars Christoph Waltz and Diane Kruger and producer Lawrence Bender, talk about the Second World War revenge adventure.

Film4.uk.title: How Green Was My Valley
Film4.uk.description: (1941) Walter Pidgeon, Maureen O'Hara and Roddy McDowall star in John Ford's multi-Oscar-winning period drama set in the mining communities of the South Wales Valleys of the 19th century.

Film4.uk.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
Film4.uk.description: (1971) Vanessa Redgrave stars in a dramatisation of the life of the 16th-century Scottish queen. Glenda Jackson co-stars as her cousin and rival, England's Queen Elizabeth I.

Film4.uk.title: Oblivion
Film4.uk.description: (2013) Sci-fi action-mystery set on a war-ravaged Earth that's been largely abandoned by humanity. With Tom Cruise, Andrea Riseborough, Olga Kurylenko and Morgan Freeman.

Film4.uk.title: Oblivion Interview Special
Film4.uk.description: Tom Cruise talks about making the sci-fi-adventure Oblivion.

Film4.uk.title: Daredevil
Film4.uk.description: (2003) Superhero fantasy. Ben Affleck is a blind lawyer who turns vigilante by night. Jennifer Garner plays his lover and Colin Farrell the villain who endangers them both. Strong violence.

Film4.uk.title: Jackass Forever
Film4.uk.description: (2022) Outrageous adult comedy with Johnny Knoxville, Wee Man and friends. The Jackasses reunite for more painfully real stunts. Older? Yes. Wiser? You decide.

Film4.uk.title: Buffalo Soldiers
Film4.uk.description: (2001) Joaquin Phoenix plays a US GI based in Cold War Germany who makes a living from the black market. Then his sergeant (Scott Glenn) takes an interest... Strong language/violence/drugs.

Film4.uk.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
Film4.uk.description: (1957) Classic sci-fi horror about the perils of radiation. A normal-sized fella gets a lot, lot smaller when he breathes in a mysterious mist. Definitely not one for arachnophobes!

Film4.uk.title: The Man from Colorado
Film4.uk.description: (1948) Western. When a sadistic Union colonel (Glenn Ford) becomes a federal judge after the Civil War, his friend (William Holden) takes the deputy job to try and temper his actions.

Film4.uk.title: All the King's Men
Film4.uk.description: (1949) Drama with John Ireland. A local politician begins to lust for the kind of power he used to hold to account. He should be careful how he treats people on the way to the top...

Film4.uk.title: Quentin Tarantino on Inglourious Basterds
Film4.uk.description: The director talks about his Second World War-based film, starring Brad Pitt.

Film4.uk.title: Gunman's Walk
Film4.uk.description: (1958) Western. Van Heflin stars as a veteran frontiersman whose determination to mould his sons in his gun-totin' image backfires disastrously. With Tab Hunter and James Darren.

Film4.uk.title: Sleepless in Seattle
Film4.uk.description: (1993) Romantic comedy starring Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan. A bereaved man gets another chance at love when his son puts him on a radio talk show.

Film4.uk.title: Escape from Pretoria
Film4.uk.description: (2020) Daniel Radcliffe stars as an imprisoned ANC activist planning a jailbreak in apartheid-era South Africa, in Frank Annan's taut fact-based thriller. Adapted from Tim Jenkin's memoir.

Film4.uk.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
Film4.uk.description: (2019) Sci-fi action sequel with Linda Hamilton and Arnold Schwarzenegger. A factory worker is targeted by deadly robot assassins from the future. Thank goodness he's back.
